rapport_notes: Attentive and reassuring with a tentative-date customer; low-risk, no-deposit framing built confidence.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "now let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns for your move? What are the most important things you want answers on this call today?" — asked before logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer worried about carrying big furniture up three flights of stairs; rep responded "Absolutely, we can definitely help with large and heavy furniture and we'll make sure everything is properly protected" with no deeper follow-up question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "the most important one is how prepared you are when we get there... the better you are at consolidating things into boxes... the less time it takes, the less money you end up spending."

top_strength: Removed booking friction for a tentative-date customer with clear no-deposit/free-reschedule reassurance, plus a clean self-prep-tip delivery.
coaching_note: Never asks "does that feel fair" with a pause before moving into the close — goes straight from estimate explanation to the booking ask.
